service_culture.name: Cargo Handling Crews
service_culture.description: Range from highly automated core terminals to frontier crews with loaders, straps and experience. Good loadmasters develop reputations independent captains remember.

service_culture.name: Independent Marine Surveyors
service_culture.description: Inspect hulls, cargo damage and used ships for insurers and buyers. Their independence matters most when everyone else has money at stake.

service_culture.name: Ship Chandlers
service_culture.description: Supply food, filters, lubricants, PPE, cleaning chemicals, adapters and hundreds of unglamorous items required to leave port.

service_culture.name: Freight Brokers
service_culture.description: Match irregular cargo with available hulls. Core brokers are data businesses; frontier brokers still rely heavily on personal knowledge of captains and ships.

service_culture.name: Harbor Tug Operators
service_culture.description: Move powerless hulls, assist superheavy ships and recover vessels that cannot safely dock under their own control.

service_culture.name: Port State Inspectors
service_culture.description: Check declared hazards, structural condition and documentation. Standards are shared widely but enforcement culture differs by jurisdiction.

frontier_services.note: Almost anything can be sourced eventually; urgency is expensive.
